fields.description: Extra issue focused on a run on Miami-area banks, especially the Southern Bank & Trust Company, arguing against panic withdrawals and commenting satirically on public hysteria. Includes local columns and brief items on civic and cultural matters, notices and commentary on political figures, and an obituary note on pioneer David Afremow. Contains extensive bank advertising and multiple condensed statements of condition for Miami and nearby Florida banks dated February 4, 1928, and an announcement regarding consolidation under the title "City National Bank in Miami" effective February 7, 1928.
